claims.statement: H8: participant counts differ by 58.2x across the three corpora ({'egocentric-10k': 2153, 'ego4d': 923, 'epic-kitchens-100': 37}) -- 'equal frame counts' does not mean equal precision. Computable from public participant counts alone, per PRE-REGISTRATION.md.

H1 (D042 reframe: live Qwen3-VL judge vs. Build AI's own published figures, P0a, N=10000): hand_ge1_rate observed 0.9545 vs published 0.9642 (diff 0.97pp, within +/-2pp); hand_eq2_rate observed 0.8266 vs published 0.7634 (diff 6.32pp, OUTSIDE +/-2pp); active_manipulation_rate observed 0.9128 vs published 0.9166 (diff 0.38pp, within +/-2pp). Pre-registered criterion is ALL THREE within tolerance; 1/3 is not (hand_eq2_rate). Per PRE-REGISTRATION.md's own rule, H1 as stated does NOT hold: this is a replication failure.
H1b (N=10000 each arm): P0a active-manipulation rate 0.9128 vs P0b 0.9096, diff 0.32pp. Pre-registered threshold is >=1pp disagreement; not met -- H1b is null.

H3 (N=2000 per variant): hand-count spread across 5 prompt variants 0.25pp; manipulation spread across 3 variants 1.25pp. Pre-registered criterion is manipulation spread >=5pp AND exceeding the hand-count spread. The direction holds (1.25pp > 0.25pp); the magnitude does not clear the pre-registered floor (1.25pp < 5pp) -- H3's headline prediction is not supported at this judge/prompt set. Also checked: P3 (gloves) alone moves the hand-count figure by 0.05pp against a pre-registered >=2pp threshold -- not met.
